 # GSE-01 execution checklist

The single engineering sequence is CP-01–CP-08 in
`docs/program/LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md#engineering-execution-one-checkpoint-and-a-continuing-learner`.
This checklist records implementation/verification, not another specification or release result.
Historical October foundation/family reports remain evidence of their original scope.

## Contract reconciliation

- [x] Read the complete SSL paper skeleton and the relevant whole significance/workflow units.
- [x] Trace the production runner, discovery consumers, comparison and publication/retention path.
- [x] Reconcile GSE-01, the current lexical design and this existing change around the active
  56-ordinary-bank path; retain the upstream 58-coordinate contract as distinct historical work.
- [x] Link the [engineering-audit receipt](../../../docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-v2-engineering-audit.json):
  strict OpenSpec validation, three-repository reference/dependency check and document whitespace
  checks pass. This closes the specification audit only; CP-01–CP-08 remain implementation work.

## CP-01 — valid opening state

- [x] Diagnose and repair catalogue derivation/refresh without relaxing noncatalogue replay checks;
  explicit repair and subsequent ordinary replay now pass for all 401,596 entries.
  Trace: `_replay` checks the saved derived catalogue before allowing `refresh_catalog` to propose
  its replacement. Separate that repair phase and test refusal on corrupted authoritative evidence.
- [ ] Preserve exact historical source/request identities across namespace alias comparison.
- [x] Upgrade the two reduced-basis fixtures consuming native YOU evidence; do not filter valid
  assertions or weaken unknown-bank validation. Rerun affected tests and the full repository gate.
  Latest maintained-suite gate: 7,520 tests, zero failures/errors, 66 skips. Whole-project ty
  reports 216 advisory diagnostics; the changed controller files pass their scoped type check.
- [ ] Pin the replay-valid baseline, basis, cohort, source/rule/link/frequency identities and H report.
  If metadata changes, record a rebase; reuse a journal only when its exact request still matches.
- [ ] Distinguish the published 021 baseline from the unpublished foundation working head, preserve
  intervening migration lineage and reconcile publication's active-baseline check without relabelling.

## CP-02 — discovery feeds subsequent work

- [ ] Add versioned durable head/candidate/surprise/task records to the existing working state.
- [ ] Consume native, reviewed and source-backed discovery plus newly grounded chains during the
  run. Retain source/role/sense witnesses, warrants, counterexamples and original dependencies.
- [ ] Schedule a candidate absent from the opening family list without a replacement manual plan.
  Synthetic integration witnesses now cover open-bank discovery, durable warrant intake, fresh
  audit and replay under the same plan; real-corpus execution remains CP-08 work.
- [ ] Teach an unresolved bank absent from every opening family; retain any legal answer and
  feed its scoped hypotheses through durable warrant intake, fresh audit and replay under the
  same frozen plan. Keep teaching tasks independent of proposed signs and audit sense aliases.
- [ ] Preserve complementary candidates, pending warrants, already-entailed shortcuts and typed
  operational refusals; candidate or legacy-vector output cannot self-validate.

## CP-03 — counterexample to refinement to replay

- [ ] Route scope/audit challenges into the existing refinement/revision machinery.
- [ ] Learn an independently justified distinguishing condition; retain the rejected parent's
  counterexamples, valid exact exceptions and null reservations separately.
- [ ] Freshly audit the changed rule and its boundary with proposed-rule descendants withheld.
- [ ] Jointly migrate additions/retirements/exceptions/reservations, replay every eligible entry,
  preserve independent support and reopen unsupported conclusions before choosing again.

## CP-04 — scheduling from the constrained state

- [ ] Recompute strata, per-answer closure and interacting proposal reach after every accepted
  teaching or revision. Frequency ranks eligible senses; it supplies no semantic sign.
- [ ] Extend needed joint-tuple/guard candidates through the existing Relation and source-context
  contracts, including multiple surviving signs and unchanged-marginal exclusions.
- [ ] Verify a complementary multi-rule bridge changes priority; limits stay unavailable and
  unsupported guards, hypothetical candidate outputs and unadmitted rules enable nothing.

## CP-05 — reporting consumes actual joint measurements

- [ ] Update the public equal-budget comparison and acceptance code to consume phase joint H,
  exact-count coverage and bucket deltas, retaining singleton diagnostics separately.
- [ ] Separate direct teaching, propagation, new-rule effects, overlap and reopened cells using
  replayed counterfactuals. Keep sigma_sem minimum teaching evidence distinct from log-space H.
- [ ] Compare closure-aware and Zipf arms with identical frozen starting inputs/search language
  and equal actual question budgets; report audit/review costs and incomplete arms honestly.
- [ ] Record the observed amplification curve across successive rounds; no exponential result
  follows from the prospective I/YOU population stage alone.

## CP-06 — bounded working storage and crash recovery

- [ ] Reuse the existing sustained writer's shared replay for explicit bounded definition–bank
  work; preserve identical single/batch acceptance and invalidate changed rules/sources. The
  current per-question `complete_dictionary` invocation repeats full preflight.
- [ ] Replace per-epoch retained whole DBs with one working head and compact transition records,
  reusing existing transactions, copy-on-write staging, receipt deduplication and retention.
- [ ] Resume correctly after teaching, audit, transition installation and pointer activation,
  including partial output and a process interrupted before its receipt is finalized.
- [ ] Verify resumption after obsolete owned staging DBs are removed; no request repeats or
  unsupported answer commits. Active/previous/source/audit resources remain protected.
- [ ] Demonstrate a fixed bound on working DB count as epoch count grows.

## CP-07 — usable-checkpoint workload and actual consumer

- [ ] Freeze the workload manifest: basis/cohort/frequency/corpora, eligible token denominators,
  operations, required bank queries/structures, labels and development/final split.
- [ ] Use the existing 90% eligible-token-mass requirement in both sources, with genre slices;
  keep every dictionary sense/tail entry and separately report missing-sign challenges.
- [ ] Repair real closed-class/contextual identity eligibility, including pronoun versus chemical
  symbol He; test parser-role error, ambiguity, proper names and preservation of correct readings.
- [ ] Exercise WANT polarity, BE own-state, anatomy, modifier/negation scope, reference binding,
  unspecified/long duration and required event/action outputs through the real encoder.
- [ ] Require all promised critical outcomes and no known wrong/missing required component;
  report partial/abstained/unavailable outcomes without treating them as passed NLP functions.
- [ ] Retire development-exposed benchmarks from untouched-holdout claims and run independent
  final audits. Finite sparse-publication labels cannot certify untested banks or general usability.

## CP-08 — execute and publish the same system

- [ ] Run one mechanical public-entry cycle that discovers a new rule, encounters a genuine
  contradiction, refines it, audits independently, replays, selects again and resumes exactly.
- [ ] Kill regressions for 3→2 narrowing, 9→3 unchanged marginals, cyclic/self-confirming support,
  stale context, source identity, alias leakage, unknown guards, retraction and solver limits.
- [ ] Complete the real I/YOU teaching/audits without assuming admission, then use the connected
  learner for the pinned common-word workload and record exact counterexamples/refinements.
- [ ] Run full candidate replay, semantic/corpus/runtime acceptance and applicable repository
  gates. Detective remains explicitly deferred, not reported as complete.
- [ ] Activate the pinned sparse successor atomically through existing publication, with one
  rollback and protected sources/audit. Verify real consumers select that artifact.
- [ ] Update the living draft from computed receipts, then continue the same controller from the
  installed checkpoint with expanded scope and unchanged epistemic requirements.

 # Engineering the existing lexicon path as one system

This bounded change implements GSE-01. Lexical authority and the dependency-ordered CP-01–CP-08
contract live in `docs/program/LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md` under “Engineering execution:
one checkpoint and a continuing learner”. Do not maintain an alternate acceptance plan here.

## Ownership and composition

| Responsibility | Existing owner / seam | Required consumer |
|---|---|---|
| Definition identity and source competence | `GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/evidence.py`, `definition_frames.py`, `wordnet_identity.py`, native adapters | Shared resolver context and exact reading eligibility |
| Joint legal state | `engine.py`, `resolution.py` | Teaching, forecasts, migration, replay and runtime domains |
| Discovery | `discovery.py`, `grounded_rules.py`, reviewed export and `epoch.mine_scope_chains` | Persistent candidate work ledger in the next cycle |
| Teaching and audit | `completion.py`, `residual.py`, `model_protocol.py`, `reviewed_patterns.py` | Reclosed exact decisions; independent admission evidence |
| Exception learning | Existing refinement command, `rule_revisions.py`, `rule_reservations.py` | Revised candidate, fresh boundary audit and joint migration |
| Revision and history | `rule_admission.py`, `rule_migration.py`, `rule_history.py` | Replayed working head and invalidation of dependent queued work |
| Scheduling | `epoch.py` and existing durable completion scheduling | Informative next question using current legal alternatives and candidate interactions |
| Measurement | `specification.py`, epoch phase reports | Equal-budget comparison, checkpoint gate and experiment notebook |
| Publication and consumption | `publication.py`, `lexicon_resource.py`, `GSEEncoder`, `publish_round` | One installed sparse successor and the next learning baseline |

Paths without a prefix in the table are within `GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/`. Split controller
responsibilities into focused modules there if needed; do not create a parallel construction stack.

## Representation boundary

The production basis is 56 ordinary lexical banks. Hierarchy and NUMBER remain separately scoped
metadata. The upstream constructor uses 58 coordinates and authored silence. Adapt only mechanisms
whose contracts match, with representation/mask/provenance tests. No prime-only one-hot import,
blanket remaining silence, silence-to-zero conversion or spelling-based definition identity is
permitted. The original sources and model request identities survive namespace normalization.

## Persistent control state

Version the new controller schema rather than silently changing fixed version-1 plans. Keep
historical replay and exact journals. The current working store owns the canonical run/head,
candidate mechanisms, typed surprise work and resumable tasks; compact reports are projections
of that state. Record basis/cohort/source/rule/curriculum/model versions, candidate warrants,
lineage-separated witnesses, audit outcomes, dependencies and next actions. Version candidate
contracts and invalidate only work whose dependencies changed.

A candidate can await evidence, warrant, audit or refinement; be challenged, reserved, rejected,
already entailed, admitted or retired; or be operationally unavailable. Distinct dispositions
receive distinct remedies. A visited bit cannot permanently hide a reopened question. Concurrent
writers, changed inputs or incomplete transitions receive a named refusal, not silent resumption.

The canonical design defines the learning-head, candidate-mechanism, surprise-work, next-work
and transition records and their consumers. Distinguish the published baseline from an unpublished
working head and preserve its migration lineage. The present active-baseline publication check
must be reconciled with this protocol; relabelling the current foundation candidate as active is
not an admissible shortcut.

## One cycle

1. Verify the working head and close admitted constraints using the existing resolver.
2. Measure legal joint space and regenerate eligible evidence/curriculum strata.
3. Consume discoveries and unresolved challenges, including newly grounded source-only candidates.
4. Stage candidate relations individually and together, preserving complementarity and limits.
5. Select a useful unresolved teaching or audit question from its legal alternatives and record it.
6. Validate the typed answer and closure; retain independent evidence and exact surprises.
7. Derive a warranted refinement or revision; independently audit the changed claim and boundary.
8. Apply reviewed additions, retirements, exceptions and reservations atomically; replay the full cohort.
9. Update the head, phase measurements and next work. Repeat or pin the passed checkpoint.

Each accepted residual answer can restart broad discovery. A rule already entailed by the admitted
closure is a shortcut, not newly acquired semantic information. A new candidate cannot approve
itself, supply its audit target, or become a premise before admission. Typed model calls remain
bounded word–bank rulings, not free-form rule authorship or whole-vector completion.

The generator's initial templates may be finite, but useful discoveries are no longer confined to
opening families. Extend tuple and guard vocabulary through the shared Relation/native-context
contracts with explicit warrants and tests. A bounded or exhausted search is reported relative to
that language, never as proof that no further symbolic structure exists.

## Refinement and retained plurality

Independent counterexamples retain the exact reading, context, conflicting values/combinations and
parent proof. Route wrong identity to existing grounding, unsupported projection to its adapter,
missing conditions to reviewed guard refinement, and genuine exceptions/reservations to the joint
revision path. A model disagreement alone is not the correction's authority. Do not suppress a
lawful alternative to make the rule pass. Unknown guards activate nothing. Review a semantic
boundary only when sources and the approved contract cannot settle it.

## Measurement and budgets

Use the exact joint H from `specification.py` with complete-count coverage, plus separate marginal
potential, filled/explicit-zero/unresolved/reopened counts and the pinned frequency buckets. Save
baseline, direct-teaching and post-revision results. Counterfactual replay distinguishes propagated
teaching effects from newly admitted rules and avoids double-counted overlaps. `compare` must
consume those measurements; it cannot retain a singleton-only success predicate.

Equal-budget arms share frozen initial evidence/cohort, discovery language, model/protocol and
accounting policy, while their learned trajectories may differ. Report actual teaching, audit,
review and execution costs separately. Unequal actual budgets or unavailable counts leave the
comparison incomplete. Exponential bulk learning is an observed H/amplification trajectory under
its stated conditions, not a conclusion from one large forecast or a log-count identity.

## Bounded storage and recovery

Keep the active release, its single rolling predecessor and one working head. Permit bounded
owned staging files during an atomic transition. Compact evidence/rule/model/transition records
must reproduce historical decisions without retaining every teaching.db/candidate.db. Resume
must validate event/head identities rather than require deleted intermediate database paths.
Protect source data, audit records and other sessions' files. Test interruption at each boundary
before enabling retention. Use the existing publication and retention mechanisms, not another
release tree or pointer.

## Checkpoint boundary

Freeze the workload manifest described in the canonical design: source/frequency/corpus pins,
90% eligible token-mass cohort in both sources, promised NLP operations and required banks,
independent two-sided labels, development/final split, explicit critical outcomes, and whole-build
replay/gates. Frequency is importance; current marginal coverage is leverage. Keep all senses and
all tail definitions in the dictionary accounting.

A final audit used to guide a correction becomes development evidence. A critical unresolved or
wrong result blocks its promised operation. Finite sparse-runtime probes do not establish general
usability. Repair closed-class contextual eligibility, including he/He, through the real encoder.
A passing sparse checkpoint preserves its unknowns and states its workload limitations. Continue
from that installed release using this same controller; whole-lexicon completion remains separate.

## Verification and current blockers

Use the scenario requirements and checklist, then real corpus execution and full replay. CP-01
currently includes the failed catalogue refresh and reference-bank fixture failures. CP-02–CP-06
cover the controller feedback, comparison and retention gaps. CP-07 includes the reproduced wrong
pronoun selection in the chemical-symbol sentence. None is closed by this design edit.

Original upstream foundation, ordinary-family, native-role and independently rooted provenance
controls remain reusable regression obligations. Their historical counts or authored boundaries
are not evidence that the production current-basis checkpoint passes. Detective is explicitly
deferred; retain that status rather than claiming the prescribed mutation gate ran.


=== openspec/changes/lexicon-symbolic-foundation/proposal.md ===
 # GSE-01: one symbolic lexicon checkpoint and continuing SSL learner

Issue: https://github.com/rohanvinaik/GSE/issues/168

## Why

USER_INTENT: the current instruction requires one correct system, a principled usable checkpoint,
and continued semantic specification learning over the same lexicon. Unknowns remain distinct
from zero. Teaching must change both the constrained lexical state and the reusable rules that
subsequent teaching uses. A fixed family list or a final proposal export is not the completed loop.

The enduring contract is `docs/program/BUILD_SPEC.md#gse-01` and the single
`LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md`, including SSL-01–SSL-11 and engineering tasks CP-01–CP-08.
The SSL skeleton §2.5 supplies teaching plus structural amplification; its controller and surprise
sections require falsifiable learning. Significance Weighting §§7b, 13–14 govern growing-graph
feedback and independent confirmation. Neither supplies signs without lexical warrants.

## What changes

Extend the current `GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/` path and its public epoch runner. Connect existing
discovery, refinement, independent audit, joint revision, replay, comparison, runtime selection and
publication. Persist one current working head and compact evidence/history, not a corpus database
per epoch. Pin a usable sparse checkpoint only after a declared common-word workload passes its
semantic, corpus, runtime and full replay gates. Continue the same learner from that release.

The active artifact has 56 ordinary banks with separate hierarchy and NUMBER metadata. The
upstream `GSE/lexicon_builder/` constructor's 58-coordinate authored-silence contract remains
project evidence and a source of compatible mechanisms, not another production default. Its
prime-only one-hot and remaining-silence conventions are not imported across this boundary.

## Evidence and current scope

CODE_OBSERVED, 2026-11-23: production references connect `scripts/run_lexicon_epochs.py` to
`epoch.run_arm`. New chain proposals are emitted at initialization/finalization but not consumed
as newly scheduled candidates. `run_epoch` withholds audit failures without invoking refinement.
The equal-budget comparison still decides from singleton/interaction counts, and working DBs
accumulate until publication. The fresh real encoder probe also selects pronoun he in an explicit
chemical-symbol context. These are implementation obligations, not missing project theories.

The saved candidate replay checks every entry but fails catalogue metadata; the catalogue repair
also refused that mismatch. The saved full repository gate has reduced-basis fixture failures.
The active release is still 021, and the broad I/YOU rules remain staged rather than admitted.
See the existing reading receipts and `tasks.md`; this proposal claims no new learning result.

## Preservation and acceptance

Keep exact definition/source/role identity, justified signed values, explicit zero, partial domains,
joint restrictions, counterexamples and original model/evidence identities. Gold and legacy
vectors may not validate their own construction. Keep world knowledge in Sparse Wiki, reasoning
in Regenesis, and spelling in SymbolicSpellCheck through existing paths.

Acceptance requires the CP-01–CP-08 consumer witnesses and the declared workload gate. A small
mechanical fixture must discover a previously undeclared rule, encounter a genuine near miss,
refine and independently re-audit it, replay, choose again and resume after interruption. Real
corpus receipts then establish linguistic and learning outcomes. Detective remains deferred by
Rohan's instruction; no completed Detective receipt is claimed. No new approval gate is created.

## Historical work

This existing change originally described the October upstream-constructor experiment. Its
foundation/family reports and the construction design's Part II remain historical evidence.
This revision reconciles the engineering delta with the actual production path and later user
instructions; it does not erase historical semantic disagreements or relabel old runs as full SSL.


=== openspec/changes/lexicon-symbolic-foundation/specs/lexicon-construction/spec.md ===
 ## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: One production construction and representation contract
The build SHALL extend `GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/` and its existing CLI, runtime and publication
consumers under SSL-01–SSL-11 and CP-01–CP-08. Its ordinary lexical basis SHALL have 56 pinned banks,
with hierarchy and NUMBER separate. The upstream 58-coordinate authored-silence format SHALL
require an explicit tested adapter and SHALL NOT become an alternate default.

#### Scenario: Unknown or upstream silence cannot become production zero
- **WHEN** no definition-scoped warrant settles an ordinary bank, or an upstream record is silent
- **THEN** the production domain remains unresolved unless an independently justified adapter
  establishes a value; no complement zero or prime-only ordinary-word boundary is introduced

#### Scenario: Scale preserves the lexical state
- **WHEN** NUMBER or hierarchy orders compatible content
- **THEN** it changes no lexical sign, zero, presence mask or unresolved domain

### Requirement: Every production input preserves exact identity and evidence roots
Source projections, native roles, reviewed primes, ordinary words and model requests SHALL preserve
exact definition identity, competence and lineage. Co-occurring arguments SHALL NOT automatically
become own-word components. Permissions, cyclic support and derived self-confirmation SHALL NOT
supply semantic warrants. Original evidence/request identities SHALL survive namespace comparison.

#### Scenario: An ordinary homograph does not inherit a prime definition
- **WHEN** a source reading shares an exponent with a prime or function word
- **THEN** applicability is established for that exact reading and uncovered banks remain open

#### Scenario: A parser label conflicts with the contextual reading
- **WHEN** chemical-symbol He is labelled PRON by the parser
- **THEN** real encoder selection uses the existing context/grounding constraints to reject the
  incompatible pronoun reading or abstain, while ordinary pronoun He remains protected

### Requirement: Discovery and surprise feed the persistent controller
The production controller SHALL consume newly grounded and source-backed candidates during the
run and persist their warrant, scope, dependency and review states. The candidate universe SHALL
NOT remain restricted to the opening family list. Candidate output SHALL remain unapproved until
the existing independent admission requirements are satisfied.

#### Scenario: A newly discovered candidate becomes subsequent work
- **WHEN** teaching or source evidence reveals a useful candidate absent from the opening plan
- **THEN** it enters the durable ledger and next scheduling/audit decisions without a manual new plan

#### Scenario: A discovered shortcut adds no new information
- **WHEN** a relation is already entailed by admitted closure
- **THEN** its new name earns no additional semantic-contraction credit

### Requirement: Challenges enter justified refinement and joint revision
The controller SHALL distinguish identity errors, unsupported projections, missing conditions,
scoped exceptions, abstentions and operational limits. It SHALL route counterexamples through
existing refinement, fresh audit, joint revision and full replay. It SHALL preserve parent evidence
and legal alternatives; a disagreement SHALL NOT automatically select a correction.

#### Scenario: A near miss changes the next learning problem
- **WHEN** independent evidence contradicts an admitted/proposed rule in one scope
- **THEN** the distinguishing condition is investigated, its warranted child is freshly audited,
  affected dependents are replayed and the next curriculum reflects the revised state

#### Scenario: An unresolved audit remains open
- **WHEN** a valid audit abstains on an open bank
- **THEN** its domain is retained with a named reservation, not a zero or signed counterexample

### Requirement: Partial and joint restrictions drive real decisions
Closure, scheduling, audit eligibility, admission and comparison SHALL retain allowed/forbidden
joint configurations and multiple surviving signs. Each legal answer SHALL be evaluated through
existing closure. Complementary candidates SHALL be considered together; limited search SHALL
remain unavailable rather than count as zero gain or proven exhaustion.

#### Scenario: Joint progress without a filled cell
- **WHEN** nine legal configurations narrow to three with unchanged marginal domains
- **THEN** the actual scheduler, admission path and comparison recognize the joint contraction

#### Scenario: Unknown guard or circular support supplies no consequence
- **WHEN** an applicability witness is missing or a consequence supplies its own only root
- **THEN** it enables neither a lexical assertion nor an admitted rule

### Requirement: Measurement distinguishes teaching, propagation and new rules
The runner and equal-budget comparison SHALL consume `specification.py` phase measurements over
fixed cohort/source/frequency identities. They SHALL separately report exact joint H, marginal
potential, filled/zero/unresolved/reopened banks, bucket outcomes and actual question/review costs.

#### Scenario: Incomparable arms cannot pass
- **WHEN** starting evidence, model/protocol, cohort, discovery language or actual budgets differ,
  or exact counts needed for the claimed comparison are unavailable
- **THEN** the comparison reports incomplete/unavailable rather than a validated learning advantage

### Requirement: Counted space and learning claims remain distinct
Reports SHALL distinguish log feasible-count H from minimum teaching evidence and SHALL require
a measured multi-round trajectory for claims about exponential bulk learning.

#### Scenario: A forecast is not a measured learning curve
- **WHEN** one proposed rule forecasts a large configuration-space reduction
- **THEN** the report retains its unadmitted status and makes no measured exponential-learning claim

### Requirement: Independent audits and gold cannot feed their own construction
Independent audits SHALL omit the proposed answer and its descendants. Gold SHALL remain
evaluation-only and SHALL NOT determine construction requests, options or semantic warrants.

#### Scenario: Changing gold does not change construction
- **WHEN** independent expected answers change
- **THEN** construction requests, options and semantic warrants remain unchanged

### Requirement: Storage remains bounded and resumable
The build SHALL retain the active release, one previous release, one current working head and
compact source/audit/transition records, with bounded owned staging during atomic writes. Resume
SHALL NOT require a whole database for every preceding epoch. Interrupted operations SHALL retain
accepted decisions and exactly identify unfinished work without stale commits or duplicate calls.

#### Scenario: Obsolete working snapshots are retired
- **WHEN** a new head is durably validated and old owned staging files are removed
- **THEN** resume reconstructs the correct next operation from retained records and protects the
  active/previous releases, source data and audit history

### Requirement: The usable checkpoint is declared and independently accepted
The build SHALL freeze the promised NLP workload and required bank/structure outputs, source and
corpus pins, development/final split and critical acceptance cases. Workload changes SHALL retain
the original failure and receive a new version rather than manufacture a passing result.

#### Scenario: A benchmark used to refine rules is development evidence
- **WHEN** benchmark outcomes influence teaching or rule refinement
- **THEN** those cases lose untouched-holdout status and a separate frozen final audit is required

### Requirement: Token coverage and semantic correctness have separate gates
The checkpoint SHALL retain the existing 90% eligible token-mass cohort requirement in both
frequency and independent text sources, with genre slices. That threshold SHALL NOT become an
allowed semantic error rate or credit for untested banks.

#### Scenario: Recognition supplies no missing-sign certification
- **WHEN** a token has a structural home or a partial head assignment
- **THEN** its homing count does not certify the correctness of its other unresolved banks

### Requirement: Activation requires the complete checkpoint workload gate
Complete replay, promised semantic outcomes, runtime correctness and applicable repository gates
SHALL precede atomic checkpoint activation. Sparse activation and full lexical completion SHALL
remain distinct claims. Subsequent learning SHALL use the same production pipeline.

#### Scenario: Homing or a finite probe set is insufficient
- **WHEN** token recognition is high or sparse runtime probes pass but a promised critical bank or
  exact reading is unresolved/wrong, or the full catalogue replay fails
- **THEN** the usable-checkpoint gate remains blocked and preserves the earlier active release

#### Scenario: Continue after a passing checkpoint
- **WHEN** the declared sparse checkpoint passes and is activated
- **THEN** the same evidence/rule/controller pipeline resumes from that successor, retaining every
  unfilled tail definition, justified zero and unresolved domain


=== docs/program/BUILD_SPEC.md GSE-01 sections ===
## GSE-01 — evidence-backed lexicon quality pipeline

The lexical artifact remains definitional: fixed-version NSM prime basis, ternary sign, sense/POS and derivation evidence. Inventory the live lexicon and its source lineage before regeneration. The **build** covers the complete declared worklist and every located lexical sense in scope; frequency does not remove rare words or senses from that worklist. A worklist must state its boundary and unresolved source-absent or nonlexical entries; it cannot claim to contain every possible English word. Gather licensed primary lexical/reference material and user-authored definitions; use cheap agents for bounded configuration selection, contradiction discovery, omission challenges, and triage. Agents return only surviving typed choices, cited source records, and uncertainty; deterministic validators project the resulting signs and enforce schema, closed basis, configuration constraints, duplicate/sense collisions, and provenance. Human or explicitly authorized canonicalization promotes candidates. DeepNSM is silver anchor/evaluation material only: LLM-generated, CC-BY-NC-SA, never shipped as lexicon content. Keep frequency/coverage, source/license ledger, abstention and per-class error samples. Do not import encyclopedic facts or world affect into lexical signs.

**Construction order and representation:** establish the bank-relation laws, stable bank meanings and hand-defined prime **lexical-unit records**, preserving justified partial profiles where a complete signature has not been established. Each record includes the combinatorial profile distinguishing its primitive sense from other senses of the same exponent. The historical 72-name registry collapses fourteen signed alias pairs to 58 coordinates including two hierarchy markers. The active curation/runtime contract has **56 ordinary lexical banks**, with hierarchy and `NUMBER` separately represented. Pin the actual ordered basis, meanings and fingerprint; the upstream constructor's 58-coordinate authored-silence artifact requires an explicit tested adapter and is not an alternative default. `NUMBER` preserves mask, zero and sign and cannot resolve an unknown. Typed source observations and coupled source-reading/type/role/scope conditions narrow the **feasible joint bank configurations** to closure before each bounded model question. The model answers only specifically requested unresolved word–bank questions, individually typed even when batched, among surviving signs or abstention. Every accepted ruling re-enters closure. Preserve partial exclusions, joint restrictions, original source dependencies and contradictions. The active contract is the [lexicon construction design](LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md), grounded in [Rohan's founder words](LEXICON_FOUNDER_WORDS_2026-10-24.md) and the [SSL learning dynamics](../../../rohan-vinaik.github.io/papers/Core%20Documents/Semantic_Specification_Learning/01_PAPER_SKELETON.md). The deleted factor compiler and experimental gloss/clause and all-prime paths are not the implementation to revive.

**Correctness includes omissions.** An extra false sign and an omitted warranted sign are both wrong. Every written positive, negative or `0` needs its definition-scoped warrant. Unknown domains, operational refusal and conflict remain separate; upstream explicit silence cannot silently become a production zero or a resolved bank. A source quotation locates a premise; it does not by itself prove semantic entailment. Trace definitional unpacking to the fixed basis and refuse unsupported or circular expansion. Partial candidates may be published as validated **sparse** successors under Rohan's later instruction; they cannot be described as completed whole-lexicon replacements. Semantic completion, sparse activation and usability for a declared workload are separate recorded milestones.

**One implementation and a closed learning loop.** `GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/` is the production state owner, `scripts/run_lexicon_epochs.py` the learning entry, and the ordinary encoder the consumer. Reuse compatible upstream mechanisms through this path. The normative [engineering sequence CP-01–CP-08](LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md#engineering-execution-one-checkpoint-and-a-continuing-learner) and the existing `openspec/changes/lexicon-symbolic-foundation/` change bind the remaining work. Discovery must feed new candidates into subsequent epochs; independent counterexamples must feed justified refinement/revision and renewed audit. A fixed list of families, final proposal export or a withheld disagreement is not the complete learner. Scheduler, admission, comparison and notebook consumers must retain constraint-only joint-space progress. Keep one resumable working head and compact transition evidence rather than a full database per teaching step or epoch.

**Validation is Zipfian.** Derive a pinned surface-form cohort that accounts for at least 90% of eligible token mass in a broad frequency source and at least 90% of eligible tokens in an independent real-text corpus; check its genre slices separately. Deeply audit every cohort form through the actual GSE entry point, including closed-class/operator routing, morphology, attested POS, competing senses, source-to-sign warrants, **missing-sign challenges**, and negative witnesses. Exact absence from a lexeme table is not a failure verdict when the form has a structural home. Outside the cohort, retain deterministic validation for every built case and stratified adversarial audits across POS, prime bank, polysemy, source availability and the frequency tail. Report false additions and false omissions separately, alongside identified, abstained, wrong, unavailable and partial by class and by measured token mass; never promote a whole corpus from one aggregate score. Acceptance: replayed full-worklist build with hashes, this measured two-sided audit, adversarial polysemy/function-word/negation tests, and unchanged previously correct entries unless reviewed. MUST-NOT: dog/cat proximity is treated as a lexicon defect merely because referents differ.

**Usable checkpoint, then continuation.** Freeze the promised NLP operations and their required banks/structures, development/final-audit split, independent labels, corpus denominators and acceptance-critical cases before the pass. The 90% thresholds concern eligible token mass, not permission for 10% wrong semantics. The finite sparse-publication probes do not establish this milestone. Require the expected justified results on all promised critical cases, no known wrong or missing required component, full-cohort replay and applicable repository gates; preserve and disclose all remaining unknowns. Benchmarks used to steer learning are development evidence, not untouched final holdouts. Pin the passing sparse checkpoint and rules, activate atomically with one rollback, then continue the **same** controller over broader residuals. Record baseline/post-teaching/post-revision joint H, filled and reopened banks, actual equal-budget comparisons and frequency buckets. Demonstrate the measured structural amplification rather than inferring exponential learning from the logarithmic count identity.
